$comment: Board structure for K41R0N/meal-planner. Synced by .github/workflows/pm-sync.yml on push; the sync creates and updates, never deletes. Milestones match on the key before the first space of the title. Gates live in docs/operating/milestones.md.

labels.name: type:epic
labels.description: One per milestone; mirrors the exit gate and parents its issues

labels.name: type:feature
labels.description: User- or owner-observable change

labels.name: type:eval
labels.description: Builds or runs an eval from docs/evals/README.md

labels.name: type:research
labels.description: Gathers evidence per docs/growth/README.md

labels.name: type:decision
labels.description: The owner chooses; agents prepare options and evidence

labels.name: type:bug
labels.description: Behavior differs from an owning contract

labels.name: type:chore
labels.description: Tooling, config or maintenance with no product change

labels.name: track:product
labels.description: Product behavior and flows

labels.name: track:domain
labels.description: packages/meal-domain logic and data contracts

labels.name: track:design
labels.description: Card system, interaction and accessibility

labels.name: track:agent
labels.description: Shared commands, MCP and assistant access

labels.name: track:platform
labels.description: Android, accounts, sync, hosting

labels.name: track:growth
labels.description: ICP, positioning, funnel and growth monitoring

labels.name: track:ops
labels.description: Board, CI, evals and operating loops

labels.name: status:needs-plan
labels.description: Needs a plan or sharper acceptance criteria before work

labels.name: status:ready
labels.description: Meets the definition of ready

labels.name: status:in-progress
labels.description: Being worked; WIP limit is three

labels.name: status:in-review
labels.description: Pull request or gate packet awaiting review

labels.name: status:blocked
labels.description: Waiting on a named dependency

labels.name: status:needs-owner
labels.description: Waiting on an owner decision or owner-only action

labels.name: priority:now
labels.description: This cycle

labels.name: priority:next
labels.description: After the current cycle

labels.name: priority:later
labels.description: Parked, with the reason in the issue

labels.name: regression
labels.description: A shipped capability fell below its eval threshold

labels.name: owner-wish
labels.description: Stated by the owner; no milestone covers it yet

milestones.title: M0 · Operating baseline
milestones.description: Every change checked in CI, core loop covered by a browser smoke test, eval baselines recorded, owner using the real app weekly. Gate: docs/operating/milestones.md (M0).

milestones.title: M1 · ICP and positioning evidence
milestones.description: Growth track. Listening map, evidence ledger, problem interviews, funnel map v1 and a chosen positioning angle before goal fitting and accounts. Gate and kill rule: docs/operating/milestones.md (M1).

milestones.title: M2 · Trustworthy recipes and nutrition
milestones.description: Roadmap stage 1. Provenance per nutrition and yield field, unknown stays unknown, measured import fidelity, rights register v0. Gate: docs/operating/milestones.md (M2).

milestones.title: M3 · Repeatable week and goal fit
milestones.description: Roadmap stage 2. Honest numeric goal fit, week scenario suite, usable second week for the owner and screened participants. Gate: docs/operating/milestones.md (M3).

milestones.title: M4 · Shared commands and local agent proof
milestones.description: Roadmap stage 3A, units U1-U2. One command boundary for UI and a local MCP bridge on the real app; outcome comparison decides remote MCP. Gate: docs/operating/milestones.md (M4).

milestones.title: M5 · Accounts, Android, sync and entitlements
milestones.description: Roadmap stage 3. Native Android and web on shared records with consented migration. Entry needs owner decisions O002 and O003. Gate: docs/operating/milestones.md (M5).

milestones.title: M6 · Closed pilot
milestones.description: Roadmap stage 4. 30 screened participants; 20 first weeks, 12 second weeks, 8 payments, 5 renewals evaluated with denominators. Gate: docs/operating/milestones.md (M6).

milestones.title: M7 · Release and growth
milestones.description: Roadmap stage 5. Public release after go/no-go; baselines and event checks before launch beats; day-9 and day-30 reviews. Gate: docs/operating/milestones.md (M7).
